overall_field_accuracy.name: Overall Field Accuracy
overall_field_accuracy.description: Exact/strong normalized match across all ground-truth fields where facts exist.

amount_and_deadline_accuracy.name: High-Risk Amount and Deadline Accuracy
amount_and_deadline_accuracy.description: Accuracy specifically on benefit_amount and deadline fields.

evidence_quotation_rate.name: Evidence Quotation Verification Rate
evidence_quotation_rate.description: Percentage of extracted evidence quotations verified verbatim in document text.

page_reference_accuracy.name: Page Reference Accuracy
page_reference_accuracy.description: Percentage of citations referencing the exact correct page number.

proposed_pilot_quality_gates.Benefit Amount Verification Gate: 100% human review required if quotation unverified or conflict detected.
proposed_pilot_quality_gates.Eligibility Conditions Gate: Zero unverified eligibility clauses allowed into approved records.
proposed_pilot_quality_gates.Deadline Expiration Gate: Automated alert if deadline is past or conflicting between circulars.
proposed_pilot_quality_gates.Missing Field Threshold: Automated prompt to search supplementary government gazette when >=3 core fields missing.
proposed_pilot_quality_gates.Reviewer Audit Trail: All field corrections must record reviewer ID, rationale, and timestamp.
